preprocessing: center zero-pad to square; floor-index nearest resize 64x64; divide by 2
split_policy: preserve original project train/validation/test manifests; independent within-class caps; remove exact duplicates of final inputs across and within selected splits, train then validation then test priority
cnn_provenance: previously saved original CNN predictions, not a newly trained CNN; trained with more data; same test source indices and labels checked
integration_rule: Only consider adding a baseline if validation-selected method has >=0.03 macro-F1 gain over CNN, positive lower 95% paired bootstrap bound, and higher balanced accuracy on the common test subset. No CNN replacement or deployment claim.
